record.original_question: is possible when f is a monotone slit mapping. A monotone slit mapping is a function f (z) which is analytic and univalent in D and for which f (0) = 0 and f ′ (0) = 1, whose image domain is the complement of a path Γ(t) on [0, ∞) for which |Γ(t1 )| < Γ(t2 )| if t1 < t2 .

evidence.quote: is possible when f is a monotone slit mapping.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ and let $S$ denote the class of functions $f$ that are analytic and univalent in $\mathbb{D}$ with $f(0)=0$ and $f'(0)=1$. For $f\in S$ and $0<r<1$, define the integral means of the derivative
$$M_p(r,f')=\Bigl(\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}|f'(re^{i\theta})|^p\,d\theta\Bigr)^{1/p},\qquad 0<p<\infty.$$
Let $k(z)=z/(1-z)^2$ be the Koebe function.

A monotone slit mapping is a function $f\in S$ whose image $f(\mathbb{D})$ is the complement of a path $\Gamma:[0,\infty)\to\mathbb{C}$ satisfying $|\Gamma(t_1)|<|\Gamma(t_2)|$ whenever $t_1<t_2$.

Determine whether equality (i.e. extremal behavior) in the conjectured inequality
$$M_p(r,f')\;\le\;C(p)\,M_p(r,k')\qquad (f\in S,\ 0<r<1)$$
can be attained, in the sense of having $\limsup_{r\to 1^-}M_p(r,f')/M_p(r,k')>0$, when $f$ is a monotone slit mapping. More precisely: for which exponents $p>0$ does there exist a monotone slit mapping $f$ such that $M_p(r,f')$ grows, as $r\to 1^-$, at the same rate as $M_p(r,k')$ (or even strictly faster)?
artifact.status_search_result: Baernstein and Brown (Comment. Math. Helv. 57 (1982), 331–348) studied integral means of derivatives of monotone slit mappings and proved that within several restricted subclasses (including support points of $S$) the means grow no faster than those of the Koebe function. They also constructed a monotone slit mapping whose logarithmic-derivative mean grows faster than the Koebe function's, settling part of the question negatively for the unrestricted class. The full picture across all exponents $p$ is connected with Brennan's conjecture and the integral-means spectrum, which remain open in general.

status_evidence.title: Integral means of derivatives of monotone slit mappings
status_evidence.snippet: Baernstein and Brown, Comment. Math. Helv. 57 (1982), 331–348.
status_evidence.claim: Studies integral means of |f'| for monotone slit mappings and constructs counterexamples in the unrestricted case.

status_evidence.title: Brennan conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture estimating the integral powers of the moduli of derivatives of conformal maps; remains open in general.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related integral-means problems for univalent functions remain open.
